description: Between January and September 2025, Israeli authorities carried out 37 punitive demolitions of homes belonging to Palestinians accused of attacks.
energy_note: Thirty-seven families evicted for someone else's alleged act.

aspect: The people who lose the house are not the accused
description: A mother, sisters, grandparents and children lose the home for an act attributed to one member. It is collective punishment by design - the deterrent only works if innocent people are harmed.
energy_note: Punished, explicitly, for being related to him.

description: Demolition can follow the accusation rather than the verdict, so the sanction is executed before guilt is determined and cannot be undone if it is not.
energy_note: The sentence carried out before the trial.

aspect: It falls hardest on the women of the household
description: Where men are detained or killed, the surviving household is often women and children, and it is they who are present when the building comes down and who must find somewhere that night.
energy_note: The house comes down on whoever is still in it.

aspect: EXAMPLE - thirty-seven households in nine months
description: Between January and September 2025 Israeli authorities carried out 37 punitive demolitions of homes belonging to Palestinians accused of attacks - a sanction applied to the household rather than to the accused, and frequently before any conviction.
energy_note: Thirty-seven families, for what a relative was accused of.
